metadata.period: Europe: 2020/21-2024/25; Argentina and Brazil: calendar years 2021-2025
metadata.scope: Published domestic top-division result frequencies. Not personality evidence or a league-adjusted global strength ranking.

sourceUse.restriction: The publisher states private individual use is intended, not commercial or data-training products using automated bots/scrapers/AI. No open-data or redistribution license is asserted here.
sourceUse.currentContext: Owner-only private personal project; transparent arithmetic preference rules; no model training.
sourceUse.futureUse: Reassess source permission before public, commercial, bulk redistribution or data-training use. This aggregate file grants no additional source rights.

limits: Different leagues have different strength, schedules, scoring environments and competition formats.
Europe uses five completed split-year seasons; Argentina and Brazil use five complete calendar date windows.
Argentina league formats/phases changed; only fixtures present in the publisher ARG file are included.
Home means the publisher home-designated side, not proof that a match took place at the displayed stadium.
Shared-venue records deliberately select AC Milan and Flamengo, not every tenant club.
Only fixtures in the selected publisher league CSVs are included; Argentina's league-championship phases can include cup-style or knockout formats.
No European competitions, internationals, other cup files, player, fan-personality, atmosphere, ticket-price or live-match data are inferred.
Source corrections, rescheduled games and awarded results are represented as published; there is no independent completeness claim.

sansiro.sharedVenueNote: AC Milan only; San Siro also hosts Internazionale.

maracana.sharedVenueNote: Flamengo only; Maracana also hosts Fluminense.
